'''menace64 Villians of the Dune Sea.... and some podraces.''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[menace64]]
* '''Published:''' 7 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Podrace Arena|Tat-D-tatooinepodracearena.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Podrace Arena
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor Tatooine Podrace Arena menace64 DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

a good old fasioned tatooine gangsta' deck.

the pod racing is there to make my opponent lose some force early on (since no one in my area races) and watto's box makes that even more.
